visualScope: Columbus Circle in Manhattan with three mapped fountain arcs, the granite pedestrian island and the rostral monument. The marble summit, the Genius of Discovery, the eagle and the bronze reliefs remain distinct across the detail tiers.
limitations: The monument proportions combine seven mapped components with the exterior photographs. The statue height follows the roughly 76-foot total, while the mapped procedural envelope is 25 m. Sculpture faces, drapery and reliefs are medium-fi reconstructions.
The fountains use fixed water levels and static jet arcs. Paving follows the standard terrain and retains native street, footway and planting data.
